articles.title: S&P Considers Credit Downgrade for Nvidia Over Governance Concerns
articles.summary: Credit rating agency S&P is evaluating Nvidia for a potential downgrade to AA- due to governance concerns and key man risks, which could impact the tech giant's financial standing and market reputation moving forward.

articles.title: FCC Approves SpaceX Plan for Orbiting AI Data Centers
articles.summary: The FCC has cleared SpaceX to deploy space-based AI data centers, dismissing opposition concerns regarding potential threats to scientific research because those issues fall outside the agency's official regulatory authority.

articles.title: OpenAI Merges Chat and Work Features into Single Meter
articles.summary: OpenAI is combining its Chat and Work experiences, meaning heavy ChatGPT users may encounter usage limits sooner as a single, unified usage meter is implemented across the platform for all interactions.

articles.title: Canceled Tesla Cyverkruck Becomes America's Fastest-Selling Used Truck
articles.summary: Despite being canceled, the Tesla Cyverkruck emerged as the fastest-selling used truck in America last month, spending an average of just 39.1 days on the market compared to 65.5 days for trucks overall.

articles.title: Anthropic CEO Defends AI Development Against Rival Criticisms
articles.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei has dismissed accusations from competitors that his company is surrendering human control to artificial intelligence, even as leading tech firms increasingly automate their internal research and model development.

articles.title: 1Password Confirms Internal Breach But Assures Customer Passwords Safe
articles.summary: Password manager 1Password reported that hackers gained access to an employee corporate account and stole some customer information, though the company confirmed that customer master passwords and vaults remain secure.

articles.title: New York Bans AI Chatbot Toys Following Safety Concerns
articles.summary: New York has enacted a five-year ban on AI chatbot toys following Common Sense Media research that revealed troubling safety failures, including exposing children to inappropriate content and posing risks to emotional development.

articles.title: Ex-Cyber Executive Charged with Defrauding Ransomware Victims
articles.summary: U.S. prosecutors have accused a former cybersecurity executive of defrauding ransomware victims by secretly paying hackers, overcharging the victims for the service, and pocketing the financial difference.

articles.title: State AGs Challenge Character.AI Bankruptcy Data Auction Plan
articles.summary: State attorneys general are challenging Character.AI's bankruptcy plan to auction off private chat data from more than 21 million U.S. accounts, noting that millions of the affected users are minors.

articles.title: X Launches Vertical Video Tools to Compete with Rivals
articles.summary: Social media platform X has introduced a new update focused on vertical video creation tools, aiming to boost short-form content and better compete with established platforms like YouTube and Instagram.

articles.title: WhatsApp Introduces Message Scheduling for Chats and Groups
articles.summary: WhatsApp users can now schedule both individual and group messages to be sent automatically at a future time, ranging from 10 minutes up to 14 days later.

articles.title: Google Brings Familiar Faces AI to Walmart Smart Cameras
articles.summary: Google is expanding its Familiar Faces AI detection feature to budget-friendly smart home cameras from Walmart, though users will still require a paid Google Home Premium subscription to access it.

articles.title: Amazon Loses Legal Battle Over Hazardous Product Recalls
articles.summary: A U.S. court ruled that Amazon must handle recalls for over 400,000 hazardous products, rejecting the company's argument and affirming that it acts as a distributor rather than a basic logistics provider.

articles.title: Google Patent Details Custom AI Video Feeds for Entertainment
articles.summary: Google previously filed a patent for a personalized entertainment system called My Channel, which would generate custom AI videos and advertisements based on user data, raising concerns about future media.

articles.title: WhatsApp Rolls Out Highly Anticipated Message Scheduling Feature
articles.summary: Meta is bringing message scheduling to WhatsApp's 3 billion users, allowing people to queue up messages in advance for personal and group conversations, a feature long available on other platforms.

articles.title: EPA Reports Zero Airborne Lead After Controlled Military Detonation
articles.summary: The U.S. Army safely executed a controlled detonation of over 9,700 pounds of lead azide at an Iowa ammunition plant to prevent accidental explosions, with the EPA reporting zero airborne lead afterwards.

articles.title: 1Password Breach Exposes Customer Names and Email Addresses
articles.summary: Following a backend system breach, 1Password revealed that hackers stole customer names and email addresses, creating potential phishing risks, though core password vaults remained entirely uncompromised.

articles.title: Fairphone 6 Plus Offers Modular Design and Repairability
articles.summary: The Fairphone 6 Plus stands out from typical smartphones with a modular, easily repairable build designed to extend its lifespan, currently seeing a price reduction on Amazon.

articles.title: FCC Authorizes SpaceX to Launch One Million Satellites
articles.summary: The FCC has authorized SpaceX to deploy up to one million AI-equipped satellites for its Starmind initiative, marking a massive regulatory step toward establishing space-based data center infrastructure.

articles.title: Search Alternative Kagi Launches Privacy-Focused Gmail Rival
articles.summary: Search engine alternative Kagi has expanded its product offerings by launching a new email service that combines heavy privacy commitments with integrated artificial intelligence features.

articles.title: Backblaze Clarifies Data Sharing Policies with Advertisers
articles.summary: Cloud storage provider Backblaze addressed customer concerns by clarifying that it does not share private user backup and storage files with third-party advertisers.

articles.title: FCC Approves Massive SpaceX Satellite Constellation Expansion
articles.summary: The FCC's authorization for SpaceX to deploy one million satellites will dramatically expand orbital infrastructure, increasing the total number of active satellites in space by roughly fiftyfold.

articles.title: Independent Ladybird Browser Releases First Downloadable Alpha
articles.summary: An independent browser engine called Ladybird has launched its first downloadable alpha version for Linux and macOS, offering a surprisingly capable alternative to mainstream web browsers.

articles.title: Etsy Clarifies AI Policy Updates Following Seller Backlash
articles.summary: Etsy has revised and clarified its terms regarding artificial intelligence usage on the platform following vocal pushback and criticism from veteran creators and sellers.

articles.title: Experts Warn Military Attacks on Cloud Data Centers Will Continue
articles.summary: Military analysts note that cloud infrastructure and data centers remain prime strategic targets for wartime attacks due to their critical role in modern communications and digital operations.

articles.title: Huawei Faces Major Penalties for Stealing U.S. Trade Secrets
articles.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice stated that Huawei faces severe financial and legal penalties after being found guilty of brazenly stealing trade secrets from American companies like T-Mobile and Cisco.

articles.title: Controlled Military Detonation Generates Plumes Over Iowa
articles.summary: A controlled U.S. Army detonation of hazardous materials at an Iowa plant sent large smoke plumes into the sky, prompting local discussions regarding environmental health and safety risks.

articles.title: French Officials Blame Iranian Cyber Unit for Supermarket Sabotage
articles.summary: French authorities have accused an affiliated Iranian hacking group of orchestrating a coordinated cyberattack that successfully sabotaged the operational freezer systems of hundreds of supermarkets.

articles.title: Frontier AI Begins Transforming Field of Theoretical Physics
articles.summary: Advanced frontier artificial intelligence models are beginning to revolutionize theoretical physics by solving complex problems in mere seconds that previously took top human researchers an entire day.

articles.title: NASA Faces Technical Troubles Across Aging Mars Fleet
articles.summary: NASA's Mars exploration fleet is encountering technical difficulties, with the Perseverance rover experiencing data transmission problems and the Odyssey spacecraft rapidly depleting its remaining fuel supplies.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Approval for Human Brain Implant Trials
articles.summary: Elon Musk's brain-computer interface company Neuralink has secured official FDA clearance to launch its first pivotal clinical trial involving human patients suffering from ALS.

articles.title: New York Governor Signs Ban on AI Chatbot Toys
articles.summary: New York Governor Kathy Hochul has officially signed legislation enacting a strict five-year state ban on the commercial sale of interactive AI chatbot toys marketed toward children.
